# llama gray — Material Reference

Create a high-quality creature appearance reference for this exact Mineclonia entity/variant, preserving the identity of the source rather than redesigning it. This is Image B guidance for the established Strict HQ UV → HQ UV + Reference two-pass workflow. Do not draw an atlas, UV template, voxel model, game screenshot, item, diagram, text or interface.

SUBJECT:
a gray llama with cool wool, soft shadow variation and natural darker facial skin. Preserve the actual source character, functional distinctions, landmarks and its specific variant or overlay role without adding shapes that are not part of the game asset.

ART DIRECTION:
Grounded dark-fantasy material realism; ancient, somber, tactile, physically coherent, low-to-medium contrast, restrained saturation and soft diffuse neutral light. Express finer fur, hide, bone, chitin, cloth, metal or energy microstructure according to THIS subject. Avoid enlarged pixel squares, synthetic crisp edge patterns, glossy toy surfaces, exaggerated damage and hard directional baked shadows.

REFERENCE FUNCTION:
Use an informative neutral three-quarter view showing face, body regions and distinctive markings against an unobtrusive simple background. This reference informs material only; the game source remains authoritative for all UV island positions, exact geometry, anatomy and alpha. Image A remains the structurally correct HQ atlas, controlling all UV structure and anatomy. Transfer only controlled pigmentation, surface richness, natural material boundaries and age to it. No new background is to be painted into the actual edited texture.

AVOID:
No dramatic scenery, cinematic spotlights, camera blur, accessories, reimagined anatomy, new patterns, free glow field, typography, cartoon design or voxel shading. Do not invent region layouts or landmarks absent from the source.
